messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the **national holidays in Canada that create long weekends in 2023**.  
(If you’re interested in provincial holidays—e.g., Family Day in Ontario—you’ll need to add those separately.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Sat Dec 30–Sun Jan 1 |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | Fri Apr 7–Mon Apr 10 |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | Mon May 20–Wed May 22 |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Sat Jun 30–Sun Jul 1 |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | Mon Sep 2–Wed Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | Mon Oct 7–Wed Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Thursday | Thu Nov 10–Fri Nov 12 |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | Mon Dec 23–Wed Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> - If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “long weekend” typically includes the adjacent weekday(s).  
> - Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., Family Day on Feb 20, 2023 in Ontario) that also create long weekends.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
